"""Slug generation utilities."""

import re

_MAX_LENGTH = 40


def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug.

    The transformation is applied in this order:
      1. lowercase the title
      2. replace each '&' with ' and '
      3. drop every character that is not an ASCII letter, digit, space
         or hyphen
      4. collapse each run of spaces and hyphens into a single hyphen
      5. strip hyphens from both ends
      6. if longer than 40 characters, cut to 40 and strip trailing hyphens
    """
    if title is None:
        return ''

    text = title.lower()
    text = text.replace('&', ' and ')
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 -]', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'[ -]+', '-', text)
    text = text.strip('-')

    if len(text) > _MAX_LENGTH:
        text = text[:_MAX_LENGTH].rstrip('-')

    return text


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys

    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        print(slugify(' '.join(sys.argv[1:])))
